shared_elements: a plant-like central motif flanked symmetrically by curling forms
row of repeated triangular/arched geometric units along a border
justification: Both surfaces use registers of repeated ornament with scroll/volute forms and a symmetrical plant-like motif flanked by curling elements, but these are generic decorative conventions found very widely. A is purely vegetal and geometric (rosettes, palmettes, arcaded scale row) with no figures, while B is a dense narrative panel of costumed human figures flanking a central tree inside a stepped-fret frame; the manner of drawing (sparse incised floral vs. crowded schematic figural relief) is also unlike.
